Hello everyone, we will be having our last RPC standard call for the year 2025 tomorrow. I would welcome us all to join so we can properly wrap up for this year and also make a list of possible things we would be improving or working on to start 2026.

Join the call here: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/87943719720?pwd=vq7rARW8AjizhE2bj1ds3oQM0OWDyQ.1

The discussion issue is https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1851
